purpose: Durable progress record for the Jastrow/Krupnik meaning-equivalence audit.

baseline.realReaderPhraseExtractorAudit: All 1249 retained whole-gloss mappings and all 241 retained alternative-level mappings are checked against original Krupnik glosses and the real Chromium JastrowReadingView.phrases extractor.
baseline.distinctSensePolicy: preserve distinct senses; never merge by headword or token overlap alone
baseline.sourcePolicy: each accepted mapping must be grounded in original source records and exact reader-displayed phrases
baseline.exactGlossNormalization: Deterministic canonical matching now consolidates complete gloss lists that differ only by punctuation, alternative order, leading articles, or coordinated active/passive infinitive markers; verb voice and word order within each alternative remain significant.
baseline.alternativeLevelPolicy: A source-scoped alternative mapping may consolidate one exact Jastrow phrase with one alternative embedded in a longer Krupnik gloss. Matching ignores parenthetical punctuation while retaining the words inside parentheses. Unmatched alternatives from that original gloss remain a separate result; More detail retains the complete original source wording.
baseline.synonymGroupPolicy: Curated synonym groups are grounded in explicit source gloss lists, scoped to the same headword, and merge only when every alternative on both sides belongs to the same group. Coordinated verb glosses may omit a repeated 'to'; the matcher restores it only when the first alternative is an infinitive, preserving noun/verb distinctions.
baseline.homonymPolicy: If both source headwords explicitly carry different Roman or superscript Arabic homonym numbers, they are not compatible for consolidation. A numbered headword may still match an unnumbered counterpart, since one dictionary may omit the numbering.

historicalCheckpoint.note: The earlier 29/43 checkpoint did not record the 43 candidate identifiers or the 29 completed identifiers. Do not infer completion from the number of data shards or from the reviewed-pair count.

reconstruction.note: These physical shard counts do not equal the historical 43 audit batches. The candidate inventory must be regenerated from shared consonantal headwords, original glosses, and the real reader phrase extractor.

rules: Use the generated candidate inventory as a review queue, never as automatic approval.
Exact alternative matches are consolidated at runtime only when the one-to-one and label/homonym safeguards pass.
Review ambiguity-flagged exact matches manually before considering any source-scoped mapping.
Review non-exact overlaps semantically against the original entries; shared words alone are insufficient.
Keep Hebrew and English behavior aligned while preserving language-specific gloss and label semantics.
Record decisions and source provenance durably.

candidateInventory.note: Runtime-rule counts mirror the guarded one-to-one exact-alternative matcher. Candidates marked handled are consolidated only when source-sense and grammatical-label ambiguity checks pass. Ambiguous exact matches and non-exact lexical-overlap candidates remain human-review work.
